extracted.name: French Dip
extracted.description: Tonight I kept it simple nice easy French dip the good choice for peeps that like Roastbeef
ingredient_lines: Any type of role bulky roll server on grinder all whatever doesn’t really matter whatever you prefer
I had some saved Auh ju, but McCormick works real well
Some cheese I happen to just use Land O Lakes white American for the sandwich
Anything else you want with it
instruction_lines: OK make your sandwich cut it in half put it flipside up in a glass baking dish and throw it in the broiler on high and get a nice brown crispy toast
In the meantime either heat up your premade ahh Ju or McCormick and heat it up while whisking it in
Put the juice in the bowl put the sandwich on a play dip away and enjoy
